standard-dialogue.npc: Not many monkeys come down here...
I don't really understand it at all. I've spent my life here.

treasure-trail-master-dialogue.npc: Not many monkeys come down here...

treasure-trail-master-dialogue.text: If the player doesn't have a puzzle box, and has inventory space:
If the player doesn't have a light box, and has inventory space:

steps.text: Dugopul hands you a light puzzle box.

treasure-trail-master-dialogue.text: If the player doesn't have a puzzle box/light box, and the player's inventory is full:

steps.npc: Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.

treasure-trail-master-dialogue.text: If the player has an unsolved puzzle box/light box:

steps.npc: That doesn't look solved to me.

treasure-trail-master-dialogue.text: If the player has a solved puzzle box/light box:

steps.npc: Well done [player name]. Here you go.

steps.text: You've been given a new clue!
